consent.title: Help improve the app?
consent.body: We'd like to collect limited usage analytics and crash reports to fix bugs and see what's used. No run data, routes, notes, or heart rate, or coach messages are ever sent. You can change this any time in Settings → Privacy.
consent.screenTitle: Help us improve, on your terms
consent.screenBody: Both are off until you turn them on. Nothing about your runs is ever sent: no routes, no heart rate, no notes, no coach messages.
consent.crashDesc: Stack traces and device info when the app crashes. No location, no personal data. Helps us fix bugs faster.
consent.analyticsDesc: Anonymous usage events, like how often a plan is built, so we build the right features next.
consent.changeLater: You can change these any time in Settings → Privacy.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: The app hit an unexpected error. Reloading usually fixes it — your runs and plan are saved.

offline.usingLocal: You're offline. Showing your last synced data; new changes will sync once you're back online.
offline.refreshed: Back online. Your data was updated from the cloud.

storeError.title: Couldn't load your data
storeError.body: We couldn't reach your training data just now, so the app is paused to keep it safe. Check your connection and try again. Nothing has been changed or lost.

update.requiredBody: This version of Running Coach is no longer supported. Please update to the latest version to keep using the app.
update.available: A new version of Running Coach is available.

coachmark.title: Your coach lives here
coachmark.body: Tell it what happened — a niggle, a missed week, a schedule clash — and it'll suggest a change to your plan. You approve it before anything moves.
